column3: Kuroneko Route · Sister-in-law and the Pledge
Finally. It all ended peacefully.
With this case closed, mission complete, right?
How tiring... That little sister over there, hold onto this baggage.
That's what I thought but... Why does Kuroneko want to step on a landmine right now?
What's this about a little sister?
Of course, I'm referring to you. Who else could become my little sister besides you?
What, have you finally gone mad? Me, your little sister?  Where'd you get that from?
Do show some respect. It's not like I want to become your elder sister you know.
...Though I already am.
I don't get it.
H-Hey... could it be, you...
Ahahahahaha... Sorry Kirino. I forgot to tell you, I'm currently dating Kuroneko.
Hah!?
In that case, you are to refer to me as "onee-sama" from now on, get it? Little sister.
Ah, you're lying... this is all a lie, right? T-This is some kind of joke, isn't it?
Kirino? Are you all right?
T-That's impossi...
She's really dumbfounded.
...Hey, Kuroneko, don't you think it would've been better to explain this another time?
If we're talking about this little sister, what other better timing is there to choose? Furthermore---
Oh! So you two are indeed dating! Congratulations you two! Kuroneko-shi, Kyousuke-shi!
I'm just being open about it. That's all to it. Well, thanks anyway.
Haha... well, thanks, Saori.
No, not at all. You're too polite. I wish to cheer you two on～
Yeah. It's all thanks to everyone that we're here today.
That's all for today, right? Let's go home early. Are you staying over at my house today again?
Yeah. My studies for the exams are proceeding smoothly. I can accompany you for the entire day today.
Hehe... My little sisters wish to meet you, so go see them later for a while, all right?
Sure.
Ooo, it's getting pretty hot in here...
That's absolutely forbidden-------!!!!
Oh, has she risen from the dead?
Oh my, what's the matter, little sister?
Don't "what's the matter" me! I've been silently listening to you two talk just now, you two...!
So you're feeling lonely after being left out? What a troubling little sister.
That's why I said that you're annoying! It's not worth being called 'little sister' by you...
How about coming over to my house if you'd like?
Eh? A-Ah... w-who would want to go to your house?!
I have little sisters too, it's perfect. You're all 'little sisters', so I'm sure you'll all get along?
Good grief. Will the two of them be stay like this in the future?
Still, the both of them are already good friends... furthermore, it's just another way of bonding between them, I'm sure nothing will change.
And, I really wish that ---- Kuroneko and I will be in a relationship that allows her to address Kirino as a little sister.
Oh my, that's what I have in mind too.
I will absolute～ly not acknowledge this!
If only you were to call me "onee-sama" obediently, I would be able to say that phrase... what a pity.
Huh? What are you planning to say?
Heh... isn't it obvious?
It's 'My Little Sister Can't Be This Cute'.
